title: Get $120 off over 12 months On Telstra Upfront Basic Mobile Plan.
body:
Deal: Get $120 off over 12 months On Telstra Upfront Basic Mobile Plan.

[mulishajp] With Boost you get 28 days you don't even get a full month.
If you have a concession card you can also get another 10% off
Available on selected Upfront Mobile Plans. The 10% discount is applied to the monthly plan fee after other compatible discounts or promotions. Concession card validations available via the My Telstra
[wakie] $39/28 days is still better than $64/month
[mulishajp] can you use satellite messaging as part of the plan? And do you get uncapped download speeds
[Wiadro] @JIMB0: Please use "lord of the italics" account.
[Yrgnuh] I wonder who's actually using Tel$tra now.
[hawkeye93] Prepaid is still ok if you can get a deal for prepaid, and Vodafail/Floptus sucks where you live. Otherwise Boost is cheaper.
[M00Cow] Bargains have prices.
Telstra are too ashamed to publicise the pricing.
For the first 12mths its:
50Gb/mth $64
180Gb/$74
300Gb/$89
But if you're travelling around Oz it's probably good because you can use satellite messaging as part of the plan.
[burningrage] Wow… Costco deal would still immensely be better.
